packageRules.description: PodiumD component versions are not updated by Renovate: they are bumped per release on the release branch with charts/podiumd/bin/update-component-version and update-image-version, which also pin the digest and update the upgrade docs and images manifest that verify-podiumd checks. Other charts (monitoring-logging, mi-data, brp-personen-mock, beproeving), GitHub Actions and the podiumd tooling's pip requirements stay enabled.
ITA: chart and web/poller images share one version (chart_version_lockstep_components in charts/podiumd/etc/settings.yaml)
KISS: chart and frontend/elastic-sync images share one version (chart_version_lockstep_components in charts/podiumd/etc/settings.yaml)
PABC: chart and api/migrations images share one version (chart_version_lockstep_components in charts/podiumd/etc/settings.yaml)

keycloak-config-cli tags are <cli-version>-<keycloak-version> (e.g. 6.5.1-26.5.5): track both parts, keeping the Keycloak major. verify-podiumd checks the embedded version against the Keycloak server image (embedded_version_images in charts/podiumd/etc/settings.yaml)
